[ASSISTANT_SAID] Provided tips for playing Sushi Go!:  
1. Read Over the Menu: Familiarize with different types of sushi and their point values.  
2. Look for Synergy: Select sushi that work well together for bonus points.  
3. Pay Attention to Your Opponents: Track opponents' selections to inform strategy.  
4. Anticipate Dessert: Keep dessert in mind for final scoring.  
5. Be Strategic with Chopsticks: Use chopsticks wisely to select cards.  
6. Don't Be Greedy: Remember to select wisely to avoid losing points.  
7. Keep Track of Scores: Track scores to make informed decisions.
